LBY.note: Only calls for AI laws; no rule, draft or authority on AI harms stated.
Nothing on AI built in the country.
Only says neighbours have digital identity infrastructure; no Libyan service stated.
Cybercrime law is criticised and a framework urged, but its standing is not stated.

facts.fact: The Informatics Governance Forum session record says a personal data protection law is being drafted in Libya under the National Authority for Information Security and Safety and is in its final stages.

systems.system: National Authority for Information Security and Safety

LBY.note: Only a recommendation to strengthen digital sovereignty; no policy or rule stated.
Telecoms and informatics law draft is not an e-commerce law; e-commerce rules only called for.
